title: Complete published-method reconstruction: 4n - 65 n^(4/5) for a uniform input-modulus family

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total input-modulus family F_n of proof.md Part I: F_n=0 for n<1024. Otherwise k is the least prime with k^5>32*n^3, m=n-k, r=ceil(m/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)). The first k bits encode the lower coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial q over F_2. Output 0 unless q divides T^(2^k)-T and gcd(q,T^2-T)=1. For a valid q, use K=F_2[T]/(q), zero-pad the m data bits into r polynomial-basis field blocks z_i, and output Tr_K/F_2(Sym_r^t(z_1^(2^(r+1)-1),z_2^(2^r-1),...,z_r^3)). The exact deterministic evaluator, including all encoding and validity tests, is given in proof.md.","guarantee":{"kind":"eventual_lower_bound","leading":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"remainder":{"kind":"explicit","terms":[{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"65"},"exponent":{"denominator":"5","numerator":"4"},"log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}}]}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one fixed total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, every full nonuniform B2 circuit at actual input length n has at least 4*n-65*n^(4/5) gates for every integer n>=16807. Consequently liminf over all integer n of C_B2(F_n)/n is at least 4.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v2"}
